content: Mbitebí Dú Akʋ Ɩwɩ Yébi
“Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ ɩbɔ́bwɛ fɛ́ mbitebí dú akʋá botsu amʋ́ nkandɩ́ɛ dálɩ beyéfia ɔká pɔpwɛ otsiápʋ ɔkʋ.
Amʋ́tɔ́ abanú bemimláa, abanú ɛ́ bɛtɩn ansɩ́.
Aha mimláhɛ amʋ botsu amʋ́ nkandɩ́ɛ, támɛ bʋmotsu nfɔ kʋkʋ kɩ́tá.
Támɛ atɩansɩpʋ amʋ botsu nfɔ wá atɔ́tɔ́ kɩ́tá.
Ɔká otsiápʋ amʋ mɔ́kɔsɩ́ ba. Mʋ́ sʋ mbitebí ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɔgyɔsɩ́, tsʋn mʋ́tɔ́ dɩ́dɩ.
“Ɔyɩ́-nsɩnɛ́ á, ɔkʋ lɔ́sʋrá okitikíti ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Anɩ pɩ, ɔká otsiápʋ amʋ ɔbá o! Mlɩdalɩ yefia mʋ!’
Ɩnʋ mbitebí ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɔkʋsʋ́ nywɛ́ amʋ́ nkandɩ́ɛ.
Aha mimláhɛ amʋ bɛbláa atɩansɩpʋ amʋ bɛɛ, ‘Anɩ nkandɩ́ɛ dedúun. Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩha anɩ nfɔ kpalobí awa anɩ klɛ́tɔ.’
Mʋ́ʋ́ atɩansɩpʋ amʋ bɛbláa amʋ́ bɛɛ, ‘Ó-o, ɩmɔtsɔ́. Ɩmɔ́ɔfʋn anɩa mlɩnyɔ. Mlɩyɔ afɛpʋ́ wá, amlɩyɔhɔ mlɩ klɛ́.’
Brɛ́á aha mimláhɛ amʋ bɔpʋ ɔkpa bɔyɔ́ á, ɔká otsiápʋ amʋ lɛ́ba. Amʋ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ bɛda ɩwɩsʋ ámʋ bobuo ɔká otsiápʋ amʋ wíé ɔká otsiákpá ɩnʋ, oyin ámʋ asúmpʋ́ befin obu ámʋ.
“Mʋ́ ɔma a, mbitebí atráhɛ amʋ ɛ́ bɛba bɛlɩɩ́ klʋn ɔma, blɩ́ bɛɛ, ‘Anɩ sɩ́, finki ha anɩ awie.’
Támɛ ɔká otsiápʋ amʋ lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa, mmeyín mlɩ ɔkpagyíɔkpasʋ.’ ”
Yesu lɔ́mɔ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɩ́nɩ sʋ mlɩda ɩwɩsʋ, tsúfɛ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ nɛ́ba brɛ́á mlɩ ansɩ́ mɛdɩ́n mɩ́sʋ́.
Asúmpʋ́ Abasá Ɩwɩ Yébi
“Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ámʋ ɩbábɩ bɔ́bwɛ fɛ́ ɔkʋá ɔdɛ ɔkpa tu, ɔlɛtɩ mʋ asúmpʋ́, ye mʋ atɔ́ há amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋkɩ́ɩ mʋ́sʋ́ yaɩ mʋ.
Ɔlɔpʋ sika pɛpɛ akɛntɛ anu há ɔkʋlɛ, pʋ́ akɛntɛ anyɔ há onyɔɔsɩ, ɔlɔpʋ kɛntɛ kʋlɛ ɛ́ há ɔsaasɩ. Ɔlɛha okugyíɔkʋ mʋ ɔwʋnlɩ́n ɔnɔ́ asa ɔlɛnatɩ́.
Osúmpʋ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ olenya akɛntɛ anu ámʋ lɔ́wa ɔsa pʋ́ kɔ́ba amʋ fi ibíágyí asɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ ɩmɔwa ɔpá kʋkʋ, olenya akɛntɛ anu dɩ́nká mʋ́sʋ́.
Onyɔɔsɩ amʋ ɛ́ lɛ́damlí ɩbɩ mʋ sika pɛpɛ akɛntɛ anyɔ ámʋsʋ alɩ kɛ́n. Mʋ́ sʋ olenya akɛntɛ anyɔ dɩ́nká mʋ́sʋ́.
Támɛ ɔsaasɩ amʋ́ʋ́ olenya kɛntɛ kʋlɛ amʋ mʋ́ lóyókwi ɔbɔ́, pʋ́ mʋ wie sika pɛpɛ amʋ ŋáín mʋ́tɔ́.
“Ɩlɔwa ɔpá asa amʋ́ wíe amʋ lótsu mʋ ɔkpa ámʋ ba, ɔlɛtɩ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, mʋa amʋ́nyɔ bóbu akúnta.

Osúmpʋ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ olenya sika pɛpɛ akɛntɛ anu ámʋ lótsu mʋ́a mʋ́sʋ́ ɔdɩ́nka akɛntɛ anu ámʋ ba mʋ wie, bɛbláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mɩ́ wíé, fɛha mɩ́ sika pɛpɛ akɛntɛ anu. Mɩ́ ɛ́ nanyá akɛntɛ anu dɩ́nká mʋ́sʋ́. Mʋ́ nɩ́.’

Mʋ wie amʋ lɛ́da mʋ ɩpán, blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Fabwɛ́ atɔ́. Osúmpʋ́ wankláán fʋ́gyi. Ɩ́nɩá fawá ɔnɔkwalɩ atɔ́ túkúrííbi ánfɩtɔ sʋ á, nɔ́pʋ fʋ́ yáɩ́ mɩ́ atɔ́ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ ɔnɔ́. Ba afʋbetsiá mɩ́ wá, anya ansigyí.’
“Osúmpʋ́ onyɔɔsɩ amʋ́ʋ́ olenya sika pɛpɛ akɛntɛ anyɔ ámʋ ɛ́ lɛ́bláa mʋ wie ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mɩ́ wíé, sika pɛpɛ akɛntɛ anyɔ fɛha mɩ́. Mɩ́ ɛ́ nanyá anyɔ dɩ́nká mʋ́sʋ́. Mʋ́ nɩ́.’

Mʋ wie amʋ lɛ́da mʋ ɩpán, blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Fabwɛ́ atɔ́. Osúmpʋ́ ɔnɔkwalɩpʋ fʋgyi. Ɩ́nɩá fawá ɔnɔkwalɩ atɔ́ túkúrííbi ánfɩtɔ sʋ á, nɔ́pʋ fʋ́ yáɩ́ mɩ́ atɔ́ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ ɔnɔ́. Ba afʋbetsiá mɩ́ wá, anya ansigyí.’

“Mʋ́ʋ́ osúmpʋ́ amʋ́ʋ́ olenya sika pɛpɛ kɛntɛ kʋlɛ amʋ ɛ́ lɛ́bɛbláa mʋ wie ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mɩ́ wíé, nyin ánɩ́ fʋ́ asʋ́n bʋ ɔnlɩn. Fʋtɔkpɔ́tɩ́ atɔ́ ɔtɩ́nɛ́á fʋmodu; fʋtɛkpá atɔ́-abí ɔtɩ́nɛ́á fʋmɛfɩtá.
Mʋ́ sʋ nenya ifú pʋ́ fʋ́ sika pɛpɛ amʋ ŋáín ɔbɔ́tɔ́. Mʋ́ nɩ́, hɔ fʋ́ atɔ́.’
“Ɩnʋ mʋ wie amʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Osúmpʋ́ laláhɛ, ɔwʋlɩyɔpʋ́ fʋ́gyi. Fʋyin ánɩ́ ntɔkpɔ́tɩ́ atɔ́ ɔtɩ́nɛ́á mmodu, ntɛkpá atɔ́-abí ɔtɩ́nɛ́á mmɛfɩtá atɔ́.
Ɩ́nɩá fʋyin mʋ́ alɩ á, tɛkɩ fɔpʋ yɔ́tswɩ sika ɔyaɩ́kpá. Ɩ́nɩá naba a, tɛkɩ nɔ́yɔhɔ mʋ́a mʋ́sʋ́ abí.’
Mʋ́ʋ́ oyin ámʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ asúmpʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mlɩswɩɩ mʋ sika pɛpɛ kɛntɛ kʋlɛ amʋ ha ɔmʋamʋ́ʋ́ alanyá akɛntɛ idú ámʋ.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔbʋ tsɔtsɔ á, bɛtrá pʋ ɩkʋ tsɩ́a mʋ́tɔ́ há mʋ, obénya tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ. Támɛ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔma á, bɔ́swɩɩ́ mʋ kpalobíbiá ɔbʋ,
amlɩtswɩ osúmpʋ́ anfɩ́ ɔma labi ánfɩ wa oklúntɔ. Ɩnʋ́ isú mʋ́a kpisíi bʋ nɩ.’
Asʋ́ngyí
“Nɩ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ nɛbá mɩ́ iwíe ogyíkpá, Bulu-abɔpʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋbuo mɩ á, nétsiá mɩ́ ɔsʋ́sʋ́ numnyam owíe obíásʋ́.
Bɛ́kpa ɔyɩ́tɔ́ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ befia mɩ́ ansɩ́tɔ́. Ɩnʋ nɔ́tɔsɩ́ amʋ́tɔ́, fɛ́ alɩá mbwɩ ɔkpapʋ́ tɔtɔ́sɩ́ akúfa lɛ́ akpalátɔ.
Fówun nahá akúfa amʋ balɩ́ɩ́ mɩ́ gyɔpɩsʋ, akpaláa amʋ ɛ́ balɩ́ɩ́ mɩ́ bɩnasʋ.

Ɩnʋ mɩ́ ánfɩ ngyi Owíe anfɩ nɛ́bláa ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋlɩɩ́ mɩ́ gyɔpɩsʋ ámʋ mbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mlɩ ahá ánfɩ mɩ́ Sɩ́ layúlá ánfɩ mlɩba, amlɩbetsiá iwíegyí ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛlayáɩ́ há mlɩ tsú ɔyɩ́ asɩtsuábɩ ɔpá ámʋtɔ.
Tsúfɛ́ akʋ́n lɛkɩtá mɩ́ á, mlɩlɛ́ha mɩ́ atɔ́ negyi. Ɔmɛwʋ́lɩ lɛkɩtá mɩ́, mlɩlɛ́ha mɩ́ ntsu nonu. Nɔbwɛ ɔfɔɔ́, mlɩlɔ́hɔ mɩ ɔfɔɔ́.
Nɛnatɩ́ yayá, mlɩlɛ́ha mɩ́ tati nɛdɩdá. Nɔlɔ, mlɩlɛ́kɩ mɩ. Nɛdɩ obu, mlɩlɛ́bá bɛkɩ mɩ.’
“Ɩnʋ yilé abwɛpʋ́ ámʋ bɛ́fɩtɛ́ mɩ́ bɛɛ, ‘Anɩ Wíé, ɔmɛnkɛ anɩlówun ánɩ́ akʋ́n dɛ fʋ́, anɩlɛ́ha fʋ́ atɔ́ fegyi? Ɔmɛwʋ́lɩ dɛ fʋ́, anɩlɛ́ha fʋ́ ntsu fonu?
Fɔbwɛ ɔfɔɔ́, anɩlɔ́hɔ fʋ ɔfɔɔ́? Ɔmɛnkɛ fɛnatɩ́ yayá, anɩlɛ́ha fʋ́ tati fɛdɩdá?
Ɔmɛnkɛ fɔlɔ, ntɛ́ɛ fɛdɩ obu, anɩlɛ́bá bɛkɩ fʋ?’
“Ɩnʋ mɩ́ ánfɩ ngyi Owíe ánfɩ nɛ́bláa amʋ́ mbɛ́ɛ, ‘Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Tógyítɔ́á mlɩlɔ́bwɛ há mɩ́ apíó ánfɩ ahá bʋtamabú amʋ́ wá ahátɔ ánfɩtɔ ɔkʋ á, mɩ́ mlɩlɔ́bwɛ mʋ́ há á.’
“Ɩnʋ nɛ́bláa ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋlɩɩ́ mɩ́ bɩnasʋ ámʋ ɛ́ mbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mlɩkpʋkpɛ tɛɩ nfɩ. Bulu lalwɩ́ɩ́ mlɩ. Mlɩyɔ ogyá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩtamadun, Bulu lɛ́layáɩ́ há Ɔbʋnsám mʋ́a mʋ abɔpʋ amʋtɔ.
Tsúfɛ́ akʋ́n lɛkɩtá mɩ́, mlɩmɛ́ha mɩ́ atogyihɛ. Ɔmɛwʋ́lɩ lɛkɩtá mɩ́, mlɩmɛ́ha mɩ́ ntsu annu.
Nɔbwɛ ɔfɔɔ́, mlɩmɔ́hɔ mɩ ɔfɔɔ́. Nɛnatɩ́ yayá, mlɩmɛ́ha mɩ́ tati andɩda. Nɔlɔ, nɛdɩ obu; mlɩmɛ́kɩ mɩ.’
“Ɩnʋ amʋ́ ɛ́ bɛ́fɩtɛ́ mɩ́ bɛɛ, ‘Anɩ Wíé, ɔmɛnkɛ anɩlówun ánɩ́ akʋ́n dɛ fʋ́, ɔmɛwʋ́lɩ dɛ fʋ́, fʋgyi ɔfɔɔ́, fʋna yayá, fʋdɛlɔ ntɛ́ɛ fʋda obu; anɩmɛ́bɛkɩ fʋ?’
Ɩnʋ mɩ́ ánfɩ ngyi Owíe anfɩ nɛ́bláa amʋ́ mbɛ́ɛ, ‘Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ mlɩmɔ́bwɛ mʋ́ há mɩ́ apíó ánfɩ ahá bʋtamabú amʋ́ wá ahátɔ ánfɩtɔ ɔkʋ á, mɩ́ mlɩmɔ́bwɛ há á.’
Bulu ɔbɛ́ha amʋ́ bɔ́yɔ ɩwɩɔsɩn ánɩ́ ɩtamatátɔ́, támɛ yilé abwɛpʋ́ ámʋ mʋ́ bénya nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá.”
